entries.label: md
entries.text:
Here is a summary of the two functions project-a will export once the farewell function lands, with the file each one lives in and the test that covers it. The table is the plan; the code block after it is the shape of the new function.

| Function | File | Returns | Covered by |
|----------|------|---------|------------|
| greet | src/app.ts | a greeting for a name | test/app.test.ts |
| farewell | src/app.ts | a farewell for a name | test/app.test.ts |

```ts
export function farewell(name: string): string {
  return `goodbye, ${name}`;
}
```

1. Add the function beside greet in src/app.ts.
2. Add one test case for it in test/app.test.ts, next to the greet case, so the two read as a pair.
   - Keep the test names parallel.

That keeps the module small: two pure functions, one file, one test file.
